presidentialSuccession.name: Daniel Ortega
presidentialSuccession.notes: Re-elected repeatedly; co-presidency with Rosario Murillo from 2025 constitutional change.

supremeCourt.name: Corte Suprema de Justicia (CSJ)
supremeCourt.appointmentMethod: Magistrates elected by the National Assembly.
supremeCourt.fspEraChanges: The judiciary has been consolidated under FSLN control. In 2009 the CSJ Constitutional Chamber set aside the constitutional ban on consecutive presidential re-election, enabling Ortega’s continued rule; later codified by constitutional reform (2014).
supremeCourt.stillServing: Court remains FSLN-aligned; current roster to verify.
